newsitem.title: USA: Dominion says Peruvian sale to free up capital.
newsitem.headline: Dominion says Peruvian sale to free up capital.

text.p: Dominion Resources Inc's Dominion Energy Inc said Monday that the sale of 49 of its stake in its Peruvian power business to Chilgener SA is intended to raise additional capital for future expansion in other Latin American power markets.

Last week, Chilean electric power utility Chilgener SA said it had signed a pact to buy a 49 percent stake in Inversiones Dominion Peru SA, through which Dominion owns 60 percent of Egenor SA, for $123 million.
Dominion bought its majority stake in Egenor, a power generating utility, from the Peruvian government in a privatization process.

In a press release, chief executive of Dominion Energy Thomas Chewning said, "... we have long anticipated a sell down to facilitate future expansion into other attractive markets and to reduce our amount of capital exposure in any given country. This is consistent with our goal to achieve an attractive overall balance of investments in the Southern Cone."
